chapters.title: Chapter 172: Humiliated
paragraphs: Daniel was caught off guard and almost fell to the ground. By the time he steadied himself, his face was flushed crimson with rage, and he immediately stood up, ready to fight.

Although Nancy’s action was so sudden that no one could have predicted it, Luis was a bit startled, but he still stepped forward instantly, sharply grabbing Daniel’s collar with one hand and glaring at him coldly.
"Bitch, how dare you touch me! I’ll kill you today!"
Daniel cursed furiously and threw a fierce punch straight at Luis.

Luis didn’t say a word, simply catching the fist. He wasn’t sure exactly how strong his 7-point physical attribute was, but he was absolutely certain that catching this punch would be fast, precise, and ruthless, without any error.
Applying a bit more force with his hand, Daniel, who had been all bluster and bravado moments before, immediately cried out in pain, falling to his knees while clutching his arm.
"Let him go!"
Hela became frantic with worry and rushed over, pounding on Luis’s back.
Luis didn’t lay a hand on her. He just turned his head and gave her a cold look, saying, "Auntie, he threw the first punch. If you touch me again, I’ll crush him into a cripple."
Hearing this, Hela, in her panicked state, froze and didn’t dare move again.
Because Daniel was already curled up on the ground, trembling uncontrollably, his face twisted in agony, tears welling in his eyes, and snot dripping down uncontrollably.
Seeing he was no longer able to move,
Luis simply tossed him right in front of Hela. Daniel immediately clutched his hand and started sobbing, letting out a loud wail as if he were deeply wronged.
Hela nearly sank to her knees, crying, "Daniel, are you okay?"

"The main issue with soft tissue displacement injuries is obstructed blood flow at the acupoints. This isn’t even a dislocation. You’re a professional doctor; you can take him for an injury assessment. I guarantee it won’t even qualify as a minor injury."
Hearing this, Hela was stunned. She turned back and looked at Luis with sheer terror.
The mother and daughters of the Wood family also looked at Luis with the same astonishment, yet mixed with passionate admiration, even a kind of devout fanaticism.
Luis took a step forward, and Daniel was so terrified he scrambled backward, falling onto his rear.
Luis said lightly, "Brother-in-law, no matter what, hitting your wife is wrong. Can you please calm down a little?"
"You poor bastard, you worthless live-in son-in-law! Just because you’ve earned a bit of money, you dare show off in front of me!"
Daniel was beside himself with rage, shouting and cursing, "You fatherless, motherless piece of trash, what gives you the right to lecture me? Who the hell do you think you are?"

In an instant, Luis’s face turned so frighteningly grim that everyone felt a chill run down their spines. Not only did Hela feel a bone-deep dread, but even Daniel shuddered in fear and didn’t dare utter another word.
Luis crouched down in front of him. Daniel, terrified, shoved his mother Hela away, causing her to fall to the ground.
Daniel kept scrambling backward, gasping for breath until his back hit the door, swallowing hard before stammering, "You, you better not try anything!!"
Hela was also startled, her first instinct being that he was going to kill her son.
But she also felt her son had gone too far. Her brother-in-law hadn’t said a word all evening, only intervening when he started a fight. How could he say such awful things?
But Luis leaned in close and did nothing, just looked at him with pity before standing up again.
This made Daniel’s pupils instantly dilate, and he even forgot to cry out in pain, because in Luis’s eyes, he saw disdain and mockery—something that hurt him more than being killed would have.
Hela quickly stepped forward and said, "Mother-in-law, things got a bit out of hand today. It’d be better if both kids cooled off separately."
"Mother-in-law, ’cool off’? You have the nerve to say that."
Nancy took a credit card slip from her bag, handed it over to her, and said with a mocking smile, "I never would have thought your precious son would dare call me a spendthrift."
Hela took it and saw it was a transaction slip from her son’s credit card, used at a bar, with a top-up of 20,000 dollars.

Even at her age, though she didn’t go to bars anymore, she’d heard of that place. It opened just this year and was extremely popular, supposedly because it had many pretty girls in the atmosphere team. The young doctors at the hospital were all talking about it.
"Mother-in-law, you gave him money, and look where he spent it. You shouldn’t need to ask me about that from now on, right?
Nancy snorted arrogantly and said, "If I weren’t still earning some money myself, and had to rely on you to support him? He would’ve starved to death long ago."
"That’s enough!"
Seeing that Ruth was about to kick someone while they were down, Luis immediately waved his hand. At that gesture, the three Wood women simultaneously shut their mouths and didn’t dare make a sound.
He had to admit, the authority of being the head of the household felt truly amazing.
Luis looked at Hela and said, "Aunt Hela is right. It’s better to calm down now and not let this escalate further."
"But Auntie, next time, don’t just take Brother-in-law’s side without hearing the full story. Otherwise, it just makes things awkward for everyone."
"Mother-in-law, we’ll take our leave now."
Hela had already helped her son Daniel to his feet.
Nancy then added, "Mother-in-law, this Friday is my mom’s birthday. You must come then."
"Well, we’ll see when the time comes. I’ve been working a lot of overtime lately and might have to go on a business trip. I’ll have Daniel come over to wish your mother a happy birthday then."

Hela felt her old face had been utterly shamed. She’d come over intending to teach Nancy a lesson and indirectly criticize Ruth for how she raised her daughter, but instead, she’d been slapped in the face from start to finish.
What was even more humiliating was that her son actually tried to throw a punch, and then, after being grabbed by Luis, cried and wailed like a baby, with snot and tears streaming down his face...
"Let me see you out!"
"No, no, that’s not necessary, Mother-in-law. Please, don’t trouble yourself."
The mother and son scurried away, utterly disgraced. As soon as the door closed, the Wood mother and daughters cheered in celebration.
Luis sat back down at the dining table and said gloomily, "What a shame about this whole table of food I made... it’s all gone cold..."

Ruth immediately had the two sisters help reheat the dishes. Even Nancy, who usually loved to eat but hated to work, was actively running around, happily saying, "My brother-in-law’s cooking is so amazing, I want to try every single dish properly."
Once seated again, Ruth said somewhat reluctantly, "Son-in-law, why did you step in to smooth things over earlier? Your mother-in-law really wanted to give her a piece of her mind."

Hehe, next time, I can’t let you have all the fun while I get nothing."
"You filthy rascal!"
They bantered and flirted all the way until they reached the meeting point with Teacher Blanche.
This Teacher Blanche truly lived up to her reputation as a jack of all trades.
Being a Porsche salesperson was just a part time job she found during the holidays.
Leveraging her identity as a teacher, she had connections with numerous flight attendants and had organized a large network for introducing various part time gigs.
Whether it was car modeling, emceeing, or other event work, she could hook you up.
Now that she had returned to teaching at the school, she had a lot of free time.
After all, it was a low tier technical school where the students were good at everything except studying.
One had to admit, the school was something else.
The place was teeming with girls in short shorts showing off their lovely legs, smooth arms, and ample cleavage.
They were all young, pretty girls.
No wonder it was famously called the Cradle of Mistresses in Hailton City.
"Your eyes are about to fall out," Nancy said irritably, seeing Luis’s lecherous gaze sweeping around.
She even thrust out her chest slightly, as if chastising him for his lack of taste, implying none of those girls could compare to her.
"Next time, I’ll just park my eyeballs safely in your cleavage, sister," Luis continued his teasing, even giving her butt a slap.
Under the public gaze, Nancy felt a bit embarrassed and shot him a glare.
But then she figured none of the students here knew her, so she decided to let it go.
The teacher’s office on the second floor was empty.
Teacher Blanche stood up, a bright smile on her face.
"You’re here.
Please, have a seat."
Luis couldn’t help but appraise the charming woman before him.
She seemed to be around the same mature, alluring age as Yana, right at the peak of her captivating charm.
Dressed in a white professional suit dress that hugged her full, enticing curves, her beautiful legs beneath the pencil skirt were sheathed in black stockings, exuding extreme allure.
Her hair was tied up demurely, and she wore subtle, elegant makeup.
While not devastatingly gorgeous, she was undoubtedly a great beauty, radiating a sultry, seductive aura.
For Luis, who had already sampled such delights, a sexy, young married teacher was far more tempting than any of the inexperienced young beauties outside.
As if sensing Luis’s gaze, Nancy secretly pinched him and let out a jealous huff.
"Teacher Blanche, have you been waiting long?"
"Ah, that car is for your mother?" Teacher Blanche looked surprised upon hearing this.
Nancy couldn’t hide her triumphant smile.
"Yes.
But it’s temporarily under my name, as a surprise for her.
Transferring the title won’t cost much anyway."
In this materialistic circle, there was no shortage of generous benefactors, but they were exceedingly rare, as elusive as so called true love.
Buying a car was already uncommon, let alone buying one for the mother instead of the main mistress.
Buying property was also rare, and similarly, few paid in full.
One could easily imagine the look on Teacher Blanche’s face, as if she’d seen a ghost.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Preperations
paragraphs: Luis at this time gently touched Nancy’s hand, and said with a smile, "Yes, I will buy one for her after some time."
"Hateful, I said it is not necessary, I am perfectly fine driving your Nissan."
"That simply will not do, I will use this crappy car for my own transportation, listen to me, after some time we will go visit the auto show again."

Nancy never imagined that one day she would be showing affection with her brother in law, the key point was he was so considerate and said it so naturally, which made the sweetness in Nancy’s heart rise yet another level.
"Alright, let us first go take a look at Gestor Palace, I will give you a ride."

He drove the two of them to the legendary number one private club in the city, originally converted from the flower and bird market at the end of Hailton Road, the current entrance was very beautiful and also had parking spaces.
Such a large area was built like a classical garden, with the kitchen in the center, surrounded by five extremely private courtyards serving as private rooms.

Only five tables were served per meal, and reservations were mandatory, the exclusivity was set exceptionally high, but many knowledgeable connoisseurs said that despite the high price, the cost of their offerings was evident.
Whether it was ingredients, decor, or service, immense capital was invested in everything, thus it was great value for money, which also led to Gestor Palace currently operating at a loss.
"For Friday evening, only the highest specification Spring Grass Garden is not reserved."
Teacher Blanche was also very familiar with the place, she called the manager here to accompany them for a look.

Spring Grass Garden was built by the sea, the area of one private room was 200 square meters, extremely luxurious, with a large round table big enough to seat 18 people for a meal, the automatic rotating lazy susan facility was quite good.
With the sea on one side and exquisite garden scenery on the other three sides, this private room, practically built entirely of glass, exuded the scent of money everywhere.
"The scenery here is truly wonderful."
Nancy could not help but become intoxicated, she loved this kind of decadently luxurious place the most.
"That’s right, there will be a Porsche then, as a birthday gift."

Teacher Blanche was communicating over there, the manager immediately stated, "No problem, the car can be driven over first, we will disassemble the glass structure and then can drive the car inside."
"The exterior must also have birthday gift wrapping."
She continued making requests, finally the manager calculated and said, beaming, "All of that is possible, we can make the arrangements in advance now.
However, the fee requires an additional five thousand dollars."
"No problem.
Luis agreed magnanimously.
"The minimum spend here at Spring Grass Garden is six thousand dollars, alcohol can be brought in but requires a corkage fee, or can be provided by us instead."
"A service charge of 10 percent, a team of 3 servers will serve you throughout, the additional charge per server is 200 dollars."

Nancy was utterly astonished hearing this, when she came in earlier she had looked at the seafood ordering area, many seafood items she could not even name, those things clearly screamed one word: expensive.
No wonder they dared to charge so much, but now it indeed appeared very luxurious, those so called private clubs in the capital were most likely just a hoax, this place was truly value for money.
After the introduction, the reservation required three thousand dollars, the extra preparation cost for the Porsche to enter the private room also needed to be paid upfront.

Luis swiped his card and paid ten thousand dollars without hesitation, then drove the two of them away first. Along the way, Nancy was very excited, chattering incessantly about the dazzling splendor there.
He first took Teacher Blanche home, as she got out of the car she proactively extended her hand, "Thank you for your consideration, with my commission I can buy some cosmetics."
"Not at all, thank you for your trouble."
Luis reached out and shook her hand.
As their hands separated, Luis shivered from a ticklish sensation, his palm had been lightly teased by her little finger.
Teacher Blanche’s eyes held a spring like warmth as she smiled very ambiguously.
However, it lasted only a moment and Nancy did not notice.
Nancy said very politely, "Teacher, you must come along when the time comes."
"Ah, there is a share for me too, then I will benefit from your good fortune."

Teacher Blanche narrowed her eyes and smiled, immediately understanding Nancy’s intention, she would definitely take photos and post them on her Whatsapp Moments, and also share them in the group chat.
Nancy would gain face, to put it bluntly, inviting her was to slap that sinister Poke in the face.
It was three in the afternoon.
Luis drove the car to the high speed rail station, Nancy asked a bit puzzled, "What are we doing here?
"Elder Sister, I have some matters to attend to in the provincial capital."
Luis took out his phone, fiddling with it while saying, "Tell Lily and Mom tonight, I might stay for one day or two before returning."
"Tomorrow, drive the car over to Gestor Palace, see if you have time then, if you are free, come find me."
"Okay."
Nancy asked with a tender, charming expression, "What should I find you for?"
"Then you also need to pick out a birthday gift."
Luis grabbed her hand and began caressing it, saying softly, "I heard most shops around here have few discounts and also few new products."
"There is only one LV and one Chanel, not enough for you to shop at."
Luis said as his hand moved up to stroke her face, whispering softly, "Elder Sister, we should have a goodbye kiss."
"You are about to become a father, yet you have so many little tricks."
Even as she said this, Nancy still leaned forward somewhat shyly and gave Luis a light, fleeting kiss on the lips.

Luis naturally was not satisfied, the instant she was about to pull away he held her tight, kissed her fiercely, pried open the defense of her pearly teeth, and amidst Nancy’s passionate murmurs, savored his sister in law’s fragrant tongue.
She too now began to actively respond, tenderly licking the man’s tongue, between panting breaths her face was full of rapture.
Even when Luis reached through her clothes and grabbed her breast, kneading it, she merely trembled all over and did not resist, the blush on her face deepening even further.

Kissed nearly to the point of suffocation, she finally pushed Luis away weakly, Luis having had his fill of kissing released her, picked up his bag and said with a laugh, "Elder Sister, remember to come find me after you are done."
"Bastard... hurry up and go."
"Alright, I won’t delay Elder Sister from going home to change her panties."
"Drop dead, I only have so few pairs at home."
"Come find me tomorrow, we will go buy some together, I will buy you a few sexy ones."
"Get lost, who wants to go find you, you pervert, I am not stupid."

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Is This Your Boyfriend?
paragraphs: Luis carried his bag and walked into the high speed rail station. Nancy sat in the driver’s seat, her face completely flushed. When she picked up her phone, she was first stunned. Luis had already transferred 10,000 dollars to her.
Sister in law Nancy: Favorability meter 83%.
"Ding... Nancy’s savings: 185,000 dollars."
"Elder Sister, you were responsible for paying the bill that day. If it’s not enough, just quietly tell me."

A meal costing ten thousand dollars is extremely shocking no matter where it is, even at places like Michelin or Black Pearl restaurants. Only a few private clubs can charge so much for a single meal.
Ten thousand dollars was more than enough. Nancy even felt that letting her mother and that group of girlfriends eat this meal was simply like feeding fine grains to a wild boar.
"Got it."
After sending this, Nancy felt her face grow hot, because she had also added a coquettish emoji at the end. Even during the honeymoon phase with her husband, she had never acted so like this.
Luis paid no attention to these matters. As soon as he got on the train, he sent the ticket information to Maria.
"Ah, Brother, I just finished class at that time, I can’t make it to pick you up."
"It’s fine, I can get there myself."
Hailton City is just one city away from the provincial capital. Taking the high speed rail only takes one hour, and 40 minutes is enough to reach her remote suburban sports institute.
Throughout the journey, Luis was sending messages. First, he transferred 520 dollars each to Avery and his sister in law, then said it was this month’s living expenses.
Actually, giving a bit more wouldn’t matter.
But he had just bought them so many things, and giving more might make them become arrogant.
Besides, no matter what, they are still students. Giving them too much money is inappropriate as they have nowhere to spend it, so Luis gave this amount after some consideration.
After pondering for a while, Luis first transferred 2,000 dollars to his Mother In Law.
It was card playing time in the afternoon when his Mother In Law, Ruth, called. The sound of cards could clearly be heard from the other end.
"Son in law, why are you giving me 2,000 dollars? Do you want to buy something?"
"Mom, that’s the household allowance for this month."
"Ah, I haven’t spent much of the 2,000 dollars you gave me last month."
"That’s your business, Mom, just take it. Spend it when you should, don’t scrimp.
"Why are you like this, you kid? My birthday is this week, it’s going to cost a lot of money."
"Mom, I’m not short of this money. Please, don’t save it, okay? Spend it however you want."
"Alright, alright."
"Mom, may your luck be a bit better."
Judging from the audio channel of the call, the Mother In Law had clearly put it on speakerphone. Her extremely vain personality was all for showing off.
Just before hanging up, some sarcastic remarks were clearly heard from the other side.
"Oh, Sister Ruth, your second son in law hides it well. 2,000 dollars a month for household expenses? Before, you always said he was useless. Aren’t you being a bit too much?"
"Ruth, your son in law gives you so much every month. What’s wrong with losing a little to us? You still want to win?"
"That’s right. Before, you kept complaining about your son in law. Were you afraid we’d steal him away?"

One could imagine how happy the Mother In Law was now. It was a shame she wasn’t right in front of him, so he couldn’t see her favorability meter. But Luis was simply catering to her preferences. He already knew what kind of character the Mother In Law was, and every cent was spent where it mattered most.
After fiddling with his phone for a while, he arrived at the station.
Luis took a taxi straight to the west campus of the Sports Institute.
This area was located in the remote suburbs but was quite bustling. Several new campuses of traditional universities were built here, making it very lively.
When Luis arrived, Maria was already waiting at the school gate. She rushed up and hugged Luis’s arm, giggling as she said, "Brother, why did you come to see me?"
Because I only came inside you once, the cheats couldn’t activate yet. I’m worried about being cuckolded. To prevent complications...
And also for the grand ambition of having both mother and daughter...
Luis smiled gently and said, "I’ve never been to university, so I wanted to come and see what it’s like. And to see you."
"We have lots of sports grounds here, there’s not much to see."
Maria stuck out her tongue.
But she still naturally took Luis’s hand and said, "But since you’re here, let’s walk around a bit."
Compared to other colleges, the Sports University really didn’t have much to see. It was just one sports venue and training base after another.
After walking around, people were everywhere. It was also boring as they couldn’t get intimate. As it was getting dark, they arrived at the natatorium.
There were several swimming pools here. Maria, blushing, brought Luis to one of them. The pool and its sides were full of young girls training.
"This is where I train."
Maria seemed a little dazed, and also a little shy as she said, "But most regret it. Some former classmates dropped out, some switched to other majors."
"Why?"
Luis asked instinctively.
"Because most of us in synchronized swimming aren’t the top in water skills, speed, diving, and things like that."

Maria sighed and said, "I used to think we could still fight for it, but when I got to university, I realized we were already washed up. We’re past the golden age, and plus, our families don’t have connections."
"If you have connections and money, you at least have a chance to fight for something earlier. But when I got to university, I realized everyone here is just poor souls who’ve been eliminated."
"But at our age, it’s already impossible to join a team and compete. At best, we just muddle through and get a diploma."
Luis asked with concern, "What about you? What are your plans?"
"I regret it. I didn’t listen to my mom. I shouldn’t have been so stubborn."

Maria’s eyes were slightly red as she said, "I’ve already applied to change my major. Something like swimming coach or lifeguard direction. At least I can find a job in the future, and not make my mom worry so much."
"Don’t worry. The boat will straighten itself out when it reaches the bridge."
Luis was also comforted by her maturity and held her to comfort her.
"Brother in law... I, I’m only a B+, not even a C. Even if I participate in competitions, having such big boobs affects the overall uniformity. Sigh..."
Maria said helplessly, "This semester, I need to work hard, change my major, and take exams for other professional certificates."
"It’s fine. Brother in law likes your boobs. They feel so good to lick."
"Stinky brother in law, big pervert."
At that moment, the swimming pool erupted like a boiling pot, with many girls teasing.
"Wow, Sister, so this is your boyfriend."
"Stinky Maria, you really got a boyfriend. Quite handsome, huh? Did you bring him here specifically to show off to us?"
Maria’s mood was originally a bit low, but she immediately nestled in Luis’s arms and said, "Yes, your brother in law is here."

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Activate Affection Through Familiarity
paragraphs: Luis was quite curious about the ivory tower, so Maria directly took Luis’s hand and started walking around.
Luis joked, "Holding hands like this, aren’t you afraid your boyfriend would get angry if he saw?"

After the discount, it is 1,100 dollars.
Should I pack it now?"
The manager named Phillipa was very enthusiastic.
At the same time, she was sizing up Luis, her gaze sharp as she thought to herself, Teacher Blanche wasn’t exaggerating.
He’s buying this little bitch a car worth nearly a hundred thousand dollars at such a young age, and even bringing her to LV.
What right does this little slut have?
If I tell her husband about this, let’s see what you little slut will have left to boast about.
Probably Poke, who doesn’t get along with her, would be very happy to do this.
"No, on second thought, that one isn’t very nice either.
I’d like to look at some others."
"Alright, please feel free to look around.
If you need anything, I’ll come over immediately."
This store was considered a flagship store.
Besides bags, it also sold clothes, watches, and jewelry.
One had to admit, the environment here was truly luxurious.
The professionally trained sales staff didn’t constantly follow you around, which made the experience very comfortable.
"Brother in law, what do you think of this one?
I think it’s very suitable for Mother In Law, and it’s practical too.
It would be good for her to carry when she goes to play cards." The bag Nancy had her eye on was priced at over 6,000 dollars, and it looked very beautiful displayed in the counter.
However, Luis didn’t understand bags at all.
One could say most men weren’t interested in them.
"If Big Sister thinks it’s suitable, then it is." Luis replied with a gentle smile, then turned and called out to Phillipa, "Wrap it up, please."
Phillipa hurried over, slightly surprised, but reminded them, "Sister Nancy, this is the current season’s new model.
It isn’t discounted."
Luis wore a soft smile.
Nancy said with full confidence, "We’ll take this one.
Please pack it up right away."
Phillipa nodded, feeling somewhat astonished when Luis spoke up, "Nancy, this is a birthday gift for your mom.
Why don’t you pick one for your sister and for yourself as well."
"Okay!"
Nancy began browsing with her head held high, just like a proud peacock.
Luis followed behind her, acting completely like a devoted, obedient lapdog.
Phillipa felt her entire worldview shatter.
She had seen many men and women shopping for bags together, but they usually weren’t married couples.
If they were couples, most often the wife came alone to shop, sometimes even secretively.
When a purely non-married man and woman came shopping together, it often involved money.
Typically, the woman wanted something expensive, and the man was somewhat reluctant.
Usually, the woman would have to act coquettish, coax him, even agree to some vulgar conditions as a trade to get the man to obediently pay up.
Such relationships mostly involved middle-aged men and young girls.
A combination like this, a seemingly perfect, youthful golden couple, was honestly very rare.
Even wealthy playboys chasing girls rarely gave such gifts.
The man Nancy brought was tall and handsome, that was one thing, but his clothes were so ordinary.
Yet when it came time to pay, he was so straightforward.
The key point was he wasn’t just buying a bag for Nancy.
He was buying for her mother, for her sister...
Forget ordinary benefactors, even if he were her actual wealthy husband, few were so generous.
At this, Phillipa’s gaze towards Luis became intensely fervent.
Her look towards Nancy, however, was filled with jealousy.
This bitch always acted aloof and superior, and she didn’t even know how to please a man properly.
How did she manage to find such a generous sponsor?
Later, I’ll have a meal with Poke and see if anyone knows her husband.
Let’s talk to him about this.
We can’t let her be so pleased with herself.
A woman’s jealousy is a terrifying thing.
While Nancy was basking in her glorious moment, completely unaware, the smiling, attentive Phillipa behind her was already beginning to plot against her.
"Honey, look at this bag, it’s very light.
My second sister is pregnant, so carrying this would be perfect for her.
It’s very practical."
"Honey, my little sister is still in school.
Didn’t we buy her the latest model last time?
I think just getting her a card holder now would be enough.
This one is just over 2,000 dollars, quite a good deal."
Nancy was fully immersed in her role now, affectionately calling him ’honey’ and flaunting their ’affection’.
Luis responded with an extremely gentle smile, nodding without the slightest hesitation.
"Let’s take these two!"
After choosing the bags and arriving at the counter, Luis asked curiously, "Why didn’t you pick one for yourself?"
Nancy, flaunting the Chanel bag she was carrying, said playfully, "Honey, you just bought this for me less than a week ago.
Let me wait until the novelty wears off before buying another.
Otherwise, I’ll have too many bags and no place to put them."
"Besides, I have a hard time making decisions.
It takes me ages just to choose one bag to carry when I go out."
Bitch...
Phillipa’s heart burned with jealous fury, but she maintained a diligently professional smile on the surface.
"Sister Nancy, these three bags total 12,000 dollars."
Even though it was an LV store, for purchases that didn’t involve limited editions or custom orders, this level of spending was still quite decent, certainly surpassing more than 90% of customers.
"Wait a moment!"
This exclamation made Nancy freeze for a second.
Having kept up this act for so long, if she were to say she wasn’t buying or go pick cheaper, discounted bags now, she would lose too much face.
Phillipa, holding the POS machine, was also stunned.
Luis, however, pointed to the jewelry nearby and said, "Nancy, the jewelry here is quite inexpensive.
Pieces cost a few thousand, the expensive ones are just over ten thousand.
Why don’t you pick out a few pieces as well."
"Buy more?!" Nancy breathed a huge sigh of relief and immediately spoke in a coquettish tone.
"It’s not expensive, and it’s not heavy either." Luis said with a light laugh.
"I can’t be bothered to go shopping much.
Since we’re here, you should buy a bit more."
Phillipa’s jealousy had already twisted into something ugly.
In all her time working here, this was the first time she’d seen a man urging more spending.
He was simply an oddity.
So, Nancy started browsing in the jewelry section.
"Baby!" Luis called her to a stop, handed her his bank card, and said, "You know the password.
I’m going outside for a cigarette."
"Okay."
Luis stood outside the door, smoking and stretching.
Deliberately showing off their ’affection’ felt pretty good.
His sister in law must be over the moon right now.
This was called knowing her preferences and catering to them.
The strategy for conquering his sister in law was very clear: guide her to spend his money boldly.
Not only would this make her savings fund grow larger and larger, but it would also make her sink deeper into dependency.
Romance and sweet talk were fine, but they couldn’t match the thrilling experience of splurging money like this.
It was also more effective at making her succumb.
After waiting a while, Nancy emerged laden with bags, large and small.
Phillipa saw her out from behind, her face radiant with pride, like a triumphant peacock.
But the moment she saw Luis, she looked somewhat guilty again.
"Brother in law, your card!" Nancy quietly handed the card and receipt back to him, lowering her head slightly in embarrassment.
"Baby, why aren’t you calling me ’honey’ now?" Luis teased her.
Nancy, feeling a little guilty, pouted and said, "That was just acting before.
Have you gotten addicted to taking advantage of me?"
"True, being your husband isn’t very exciting.
Being your brother in law is much more thrilling.
I never expected Big Sister to have such a... vulgar interest." Luis continued teasing her.
He put the card away and picked up the receipt.
Now he knew why she looked so guilty.
She had spent 25,000 dollars.
Nancy explained with a guilty conscience, "Well, I thought Lily and my younger sister would also wear my jewelry, so I bought a few more pieces."
"Phillipa recommended them so enthusiastically, and the discount seemed good, so I just went ahead and bought them..."
Luis smiled gently and took her hand.
In one smooth motion, he accepted the bags she was carrying and said with a warm smile, "If Big Sister picked them out, they must be beautiful.
Then the money was well spent."
The favorability meter hadn’t refreshed yet.
But his sister-in-law Nancy’s savings had already reached the 200,000 dollar mark.
Seeing Luis’s tender and considerate smile, Phillipa, standing behind the glass door, was already green with envy, her face practically contorted.
It was impossible for any man to be this generous and broad-minded, spending so much money without a hint of regret.
What was more, that bitch Nancy always put on a cold, aloof front, never knew how to act cute or properly please a man.
She didn’t deserve this.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: I Remember Your Kindness... I Know Your Intentions...
paragraphs: "Lily will be furious if she finds out, won’t she? She spent so much."
When it came to being a green tea bitch, his sister-in-law was undoubtedly the queen. Swiping the card had felt amazing, but now she was using this kind of tone.
"Just don’t tell her. The secrets between us are piling up, you know."

Luis kissed her cheek and teased with a playful grin, "Mom is always worried I’ll spend money on vixens outside. Well, now that I’m spending it on a vixen right here at home, she can’t possibly find fault with that."
"Get lost, who’s a vixen?"
"My sister-in-law is even more beautiful and tempting than any vixen."

Bantering and flirting all the way, they arrived at the five-star riverside hotel. Nancy, her face flushed, said, "Phillipa recommended this place to me. The private restaurant on the top floor is the most famous around here."
"She has a membership card here. If you provide her phone number, you get a 10 percent discount, and it helps her accumulate points too."
"Phillipa was incredibly enthusiastic, she even called ahead to reserve a table for us."
Hearing this, Luis revealed a meaningful smile. Nancy felt completely exposed, as if she were standing there naked, every one of her thoughts laid bare before her brother-in-law.

Dining at this place was definitely expensive. Once the bill was settled, a message would surely be sent to that Phillipa, probably including the spending amount for verification. To put it bluntly, Nancy didn’t want to miss a single opportunity to show off.
As for that Phillipa, her enthusiasm was driven by pure jealousy and a desire to keep testing the waters, which was exactly why Nancy felt compelled to accept, even if it was awkward.
Nancy felt as if all her secrets had been completely seen through.
She lowered her head, somewhat embarrassed.
But what made her secretly pleased was that her brother-in-law seemed to be a mind reader, intuitively knowing every single one of her thoughts.
"Although I don’t really like food of expensive restaurant.
Since Big Sister has already accepted the invitation."
Luis continued holding her hand, his smile warm and unhurried as he said, "Then we’ll order the most expensive items. We can’t let her look down on us."
"Okay."
Nancy’s smile was exquisitely charming. This was the power of real money, giving her a tangible sense of the happiness that comes from being utterly pampered.

Materially, she felt the thrill of being provided for, and spiritually, the bliss of being doted on. Gazing at her gentle and considerate brother-in-law, Nancy grew more and more resentful. How could her plain-looking younger sister have landed such an exceptional husband.
The private club was located on the top floor of the hotel. At the reception, they provided Phillipa’s mobile number.
The manager led them warmly, saying, "The two of you have reserved our best seats with a view. The minimum spend is 600 dollars, with a 10 percent service charge."
The private room offered strong privacy, though it wasn’t the formal type used for business banquets. Instead, a table and chairs were arranged before a massive floor-to-ceiling window.

Through the glass, they enjoyed the city’s most beautiful river view. The surroundings were decorated with a very upscale ambiance, definitely that European-American style, though Luis couldn’t quite pinpoint what exactly made it so high-end.
"Wow, it’s so beautiful."
Nancy immediately pulled out her phone and started snapping pictures feverishly, taking selfies and photos of the scenery, though she didn’t dare take any pictures with Luis.
Sitting down across from her, Luis didn’t mind. He picked up the menu first and then asked, "Big Sister, how about we order before you play with your phone?"
Nancy took the menu, glanced at it, and was immediately taken aback. No wonder they claimed to be the best around; almost every main course was priced in the hundreds.
"You order."
Nancy promptly pushed the menu back to him.

"Hello, we’ll have one Boston Lobster with Blue Cheese, two portions of Cod with French Foie Gras Sauce, one portion of Oil-Blanched Whole Pound Black Gold Abalone Slices, and Matsutake Grilled Marbled..."
"Any other recommendations?"
Luis inquired.
The manager input the order on an iPad, smiling as he said, "Our chef’s signature is the French-style King Crab Leg dish, and our signature main course is the Pacific Meat Crab Rice Bowl."
"We’ll have one of each, then."
Luis closed the menu and asked gently, "Big Sister, that should be enough, right?"
"Definitely enough."
Nancy was a little stunned; she had skimmed the prices, and just these few items added up to well over a thousand dollars.
"Sir, would you like soup or wine with your meal?"

Nancy picked up the menu again. Even the cheapest Borscht started at 38 dollars, which made her wince. Seeing that the red wines were generally priced around 60 dollars and up, she quickly ordered a bottle of red wine.
"If Lily finds out about this, she’ll skin me alive."
Nancy did a quick mental calculation.
This meal was going to cost nearly two thousand dollars. It was outrageously extravagant.

Luis lit a cigarette, smiled lightly, and said, "Big Sister, just go ahead and post it openly on your social media. If she asks, I’ll just say I was entertaining a business associate. Don’t worry, she won’t ask about the price."
"Got it."

Nancy’s gaze grew even softer, amazed by her brother-in-law’s perceptiveness and consideration. She felt a little embarrassed that her petty thoughts were so easily read, but even more, she felt the joy of having someone who truly understood her.
The red wine arrived first. A waiter, dressed like a proper foreign butler and wearing white gloves, stood by to pour the wine. If nothing else, the atmosphere was absolutely top-notch.
He also very thoughtfully asked, "Sir, Madam, would you like a ring light for taking photos? It’s complimentary."
"Yes, thank you."

Luis couldn’t help but smile, thinking to himself that this place’s success was well-deserved. They understood that customers coming here were bursting with vanity and, for the sake of indirect promotion, were willing to go the extra mile.
The food arrived quickly. Nancy couldn’t wait to start taking photos, holding the elegant stemware, with the stunning night view through the floor-to-ceiling window as her backdrop.
With every dish that was served, Luis tactfully waited without starting, accompanying her as she took pictures and even helping her select the best ones.

They hadn’t even touched their chopsticks by the time all the dishes were on the table, even taking a ’group photo’ of the entire spread. Nancy started to feel a bit embarrassed, "Brother-in-law, let’s eat quickly. It won’t taste as good if it gets cold."
"Alright, cheers."
Luis raised his glass and clinked it with hers.

The wine itself wasn’t intoxicating, but the atmosphere was. Seeing her face filled with vain, satisfied rapture, that very allure made Luis’s heart stir with restless excitement, eagerly anticipating the night that lay ahead.
Such a high end restaurant, is exactly what Nancy has always dreamed of, but it is also something that Daniel could never provide for her.

That wasteful husband of hers had enough money to throw away in bars, but he would never take her to a place like this for dinner. So once again, Nancy compared her husband with the gentle and considerate brother in law in front of her, and her jealousy towards her sister skyrocketed yet again.
"Lily asked what time we are going back?"
Nancy checked her Whatsapp and asked softly.
Luis, right in front of her, directly sent a voice message to Lily: "Wife, something came up and we have to go back tomorrow. My elder sister and I will stay in the capital for the night."
"She said she made plans to hang out with classmates tonight. I will go back to the hotel by myself later, go for a swim to exercise, and then just go to sleep."
After sending this, Nancy’s face turned completely red, both from the wine and a slightly shy blush.
She lowered her head and thought for a long while, then said softly, "Brother in law, you promised me. We cannot do anything to let Lily down. She is my biological sister."
"I still remember!"

Luis immediately declared with great conviction, "Elder Sister, can you not see my feelings for you? If it were any other woman, just for the sake of venting desire, do you think I would care so much?"
His words were filled with sincerity and deep affection, which Nancy naturally felt. The women in this circle are all very realistic, they would do anything for money.
Comparing it again to Chloe’s situation, she understood even more clearly how precious these genuine financial investments were.

If an outsider tried to take advantage of the situation now, they would have long since coerced her into selling her body. Moreover, how many outsiders would be willing to spend so much money to help her?
Yet, her brother in law treated her with such care, such caution, filled with love and consideration. Nancy was no fool; she had long been deeply moved.
The investment of real money, coupled with such thoughtful effort, was a kind of affection she had never experienced before. It completely shattered this wife’s shameful reserve.
"I know!"

The wine was intoxicating, especially with the romantic piano music playing in congratulations. Nancy’s eyes were exceptionally soft and charming as she said, "You stinky brother in law, I know your intentions are the same as other men’s. But your kindness towards me, your elder sister sees it all and remembers it in her heart."

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Periodꨄ︎...
paragraphs: "But, but..."
She seemed to have some unspeakable difficulty. Luis immediately held her hand and said tenderly, "Elder Sister, could it be that you are still keeping secrets from me?"
"No!"
Nancy thought for a moment, then, gritting her teeth with a blushing face, said, "But my period came!!!"

Luis was stunned at first, but then he realized that his sister in law had come to the capital to find him. A lone man and a lone woman together, she had actually been mentally prepared to offer herself.

To put it bluntly, the favorability meter indeed wasn’t high enough yet, but the amount of real money spent was already sufficient. He guessed that she herself felt somewhat ashamed for not having slept with him even once. Of course, the main reason was that Luis handled the details very well.

Now Luis understood. The difficulty in refreshing the favorability meter was mainly because she was too conflicted. He had done enough in terms of interactions between a man and a woman, but the shackles of this relationship remained.
Seeing Luis stunned, Nancy grew a little anxious, her face flushing red as she said, "If you do not believe me, I can show you the panty liner."
Luis thought for a moment, then gently held her hand, stroking it, and said, "Elder Sister, how could I not believe you? But what does that matter."
"You, do not be silly. Even if my period had not come, I am Lily’s biological sister. You cannot touch me."
This coy side of a woman felt so genuine. Seducing a faithful wife to cheat is inherently difficult.
Although Nancy is vain and materialistic, deep down, due to her mother in law’s strict teachings, she is very conservative. For her, the shackles of this relationship are even more terrifying.

Perhaps she could lose her virginity to some stranger for money, but it would be psychologically difficult if the other person was her own brother in law. After all, women are bound more tightly by ethics and morality.

Unlike Luis, who was like a beast, the very thought that this was his sister in law excited him tremendously. If it were an ordinary woman, no matter how breathtakingly beautiful, without this relationship, the temptation wouldn’t be nearly as strong.
A sister in law can also be coy and sentimental.
But to Luis, it did not matter.
Completing the tasks issued by the System and obtaining the rewards, rather than immediately fucking her in one step, meant that Luis now possessed exceptional patience.
Of course, his patience was ample also because he had already vented his desires on Maria, allowing him to have calm, wise moments of clarity.
So Luis gently held her hand and said, "Elder Sister, I promised you, and that will not change. It is true that I will seek out other women, but you should know my feelings for you."
"I know..."
Nancy lowered her head, somewhat ashamed.
If it were another person, a stranger, not to mention helping her pay off so much debt.

Just being so considerate, caring for her feelings, being tender with her every single moment, and spending heavily to satisfy these vanities of hers, she would have long since succumbed. She would probably be trying to please this man more lewdly than a prostitute.
But Luis was her own brother in law... Nancy even felt that her own reserve, her tsundere attitude, were ridiculous, and even an insult to him.
She had clearly willingly accepted all this kindness towards her, yet she still said those coy, sentimental words.
"Elder Sister!
Luis caressed her slender, delicate hand and said emotionally, "I am a man. You also know what men are like. I cannot avoid being vulgar."

"From the first moment I saw you, I have wanted to fuck you every single second... In my wet dreams, I thought about all the positions to fuck you in. Even when we were buying the car, I thought about having sex in it."
"Pervert!"
